text:
Tara: Heads-up team 1 new hire Naomi Park scheduled to start Mon 2024-04-14. Flight arrives Sun 20:10. Checkr shows 'Pending  identity docs requested'. I-9 slot was set for Mon 10:00 but security desk staffing ends 18:30 so late badge pickup won't work. What are options? :thinking_face:
Emily: Can we move I-9 to early morning 08:15? Or arrange a mobile notary Sunday evening at candidate expense if necessary. Mobile costs extra and needs approval.
Raj: Checkr often clears quickly if passport uploaded. Do we have candidate passport scan? If yes, we can push verification earlier. I can cover 08:15.
Security-Team: Received. We can issue a temporary visitor pass for verification but full badge issuance requires BG clear. Need name + photo copy at reception.
Lena-Courier: Im available for airport document pickup Sun up to ~23:00. Will need explicit written consent from Naomi and a verified photo ID to accept. Courier fee applies if Ops covers.
Tara: DMing Naomi now to confirm consent and acceptable pickup time.
Emily: Logistically if courier picks up Sun we can deliver paperwork to Kiosk A Mon 07:30 for Raj to verify before security shift ends. Ops volunteer needed to accompany courier handoff.
Raj: Ill take the 08:15 verification slot Monday. @Security-Team please arrange temp pass and reception briefing.
Security-Team: Confirmed. Reception will issue temp pass at 08:00 to escort Naomi to verification desk.
People-ops-bot: Candidate Naomi Park submitted DocuSign I-9 consent. Checkr portal: https://checkr.example/naomi (candidate id 78901).
Mike: IT note  Naomi's laptop delayed and will arrive Mon AM. I will label and secure the device at reception "NAOMI PARK - HOLD" and hand to Raj after I-9 verification.
Emily: Day-1 quick checklist:
- 08:00 Naomi arrival, temp visitor pass from reception
- 08:15 I-9 verification (Raj)
- 08:45 Laptop handoff (Mike)
- 09:15 Manager 1:1 + orientation kickoff
- Badge issuance after BG clearance
Raj: If Checkr flags anything adverse, fallback plan = remote-first day + buddy onboarding. @Tara please prep escalation template for HR review.
Tara: Escalation doc added: https://redwoodhr.docs/onboard/escalation-template. Ping me for urgent review.
Naomi: (candidate) Hi all  Thank you! I consent to courier pickup. I can meet at Terminal 3 baggage claim at 21:15 Sun. Appreciate the flexibility.
Emily: Great. I'll send Naomi the Day-1 itinerary, courier contact, and Raj's phone. Also reserving a hybrid desk in SF-2 for week 1.
People-ops-bot: Thread updated  badge hold placed; kiosk reschedule pending. :white_check_mark:
